paragraphs: The 430d has been a mainstay of the 4 Series diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early F32/F33/F36 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the F32/F33/F36 and later the F32/F33/F36, the 430d switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The 430d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the 430d is a single-engine variant within the 4 Series range, compatibility is more straightforward than on multi-engine variants. However, the B57 is specific to the G22/G23/G26 generation — it was not used in the previous F32/F33/F36 430d, which used the older N57 engine. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
